name: Kernel the Butter-Patch Cat
blurb: Kernel, a fluffy cream-white cat with butter-yellow patches and honey-gold eyes, waits by the garden bench for anything that pops.

name: Matinee the Velvet-Black Cat
blurb: Matinee, a sleek jet-black shorthair with pale gold eyes, naps all afternoon in the darkest, softest corner of the garden shed.

name: Reeltail the Silver Tabby Cat
blurb: Reeltail, a silver tabby with a long tail ringed in black bands, sits on the warm garden wall watching the evening sky like a big screen.
